title: Prove exact D4 carrier interfaces and paid helper return
body:
## Summary

Complete one fixed twelve-port D4 carrier interface. The four-helper OPEN bus is exactly the zero-helper public carrier direct-summed with four independent rank-three helper channels, on all 28 arbitrary entering fields. The complete native rank masses are 136 for OPEN, 144 for the full-source variant and 148 for the bus. An explicit paid helper-return tail raises the bus to 160 and returns each helper value identically.

Eight explicit A/B star involutions and four frozen C-port monomial gauges normalize both orientations with their actual global phases. A written split-Lagrangian lemma gives the general existence criterion. A second general lemma proves the output inverse-B wrapper is monomial under the native common-F hypotheses; the input wrapper is checked for the four explicit witnesses. The physical kernel and logical code, raw ID swaps, native monomial legs and all wrapper scans are distinguished.

## Scope and limits

This is a fixed 12-port h7 result, not uniform coverage of all 112 P112 ports. The parent tiling includes 120 labels with eight omitted. Fixed physical-ID query products and moved-value endpoint ranks differ and are kept separate. The helper-return tail removes helper-progress credit. No global caller, owner allocation, rounded precision, tape implementation, gauge optimum or new kappa is claimed. Historical search receipts are provenance; no discovery search is repeated.

## Test plan

Standard-library CPython 3.12 registered replay: exact arbitrary-input words in four orientations, full native phases and histograms, literal scalar swaps, paid monomial lowerings, 4096 independently interpreted C-port monomial columns, 8192 A/B star monomial columns, actual semantic mutations and named-check deletion controls. The final committed package passed its source-history/byte preflight and all four registered commands. All four commands also passed from a read-only Git-free committed export. Automatic [registered-package CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39436404454) passed at exact head `7bfd6d472023e41f8c3ccc0d20641c70400ebd2b`.

## Sources and credit

Scientific pin `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; unchanged Gaussian-dyadic Clifford compiler and PR531/PR533/kernel92 notices are retained with exact source hashes. Original local carrier, bus and normalization witnesses remain unchanged under frozen/history. Prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI mathematical review contexts. Standard Clifford normalization and symplectic facts, inherited compiler work and earlier supplier architecture are not claimed as new. No independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is implied.
